title: A written policy increases compliance with guidelines for therapeutic anticoagulation prior to elective direct current cardioversion of atrial fibrillation.
topic: Anticoagulation before elective cardioversion of atrial fibrillation
standard: Guidelines for therapeutic anticoagulation (INR 2.0 or more for at least 3 weeks, or negative TEE with INR 2.0 or more or PTT over 50 seconds) before elective direct current cardioversion
finding: 14 of 52 patients (27%) had cardioversion without adequate anticoagulation or a negative TEE.
change: Written anticoagulation policy sent to physicians who perform, prepare or refer patients for cardioversion; nurse assigned to each cardioversion documented anticoagulation status.
